summary: Iter 3/4/5 verification — 23/24 backend pytests pass; all 6 new frontend pages render & integrate correctly. One real backend bug found: /api/invoices/ocr-extract returns 500 (instead of the documented 502) because emergentintegrations' ImageContent class only accepts image_base64, not image_url. Everything else (Categories CRUD with RBAC, Compliance dossier with 8 checks, change-password, notification prefs, POs+GRNs seed/CRUD/ack, operations stats, invoice seed+stats, 3-way match engine for NO_PO/NO_GRN/AMOUNT_VAR/auto_approved verdicts, run-bot, rerun-match) verified end-to-end.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 (Internal Server Error) instead of the spec'd 200/502 fallback. RCA: server.py line 1935 calls ImageContent(image_url=body.image_url) but the installed emergentintegrations.llm.chat.ImageContent signature is __init__(self, image_base64: str) — TypeError thrown before the try/except around chat.send_message. Fix: either (a) fetch the URL with httpx, base64-encode the bytes, and pass image_base64=..., or (b) use FileContentWithMimeType / upload helpers from emergentintegrations (recommended — check the integration playbook for the GPT-4o vision pattern). Also recommend wrapping the ImageContent construction inside the same try/except so any mis-call yields 502 instead of 500.

minor.issue: Cache freshness check at line 1326 mixes tzinfo handling oddly: `(now_utc() - ts.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if ts.tzinfo is None else now_utc() - ts).total_seconds()`. Works today because mongo returns naive datetime, but if a future migration stores tz-aware datetimes, the else branch will raise. Cleaner: normalise ts to UTC before the subtract.
scheduled_amount only sums auto_approved invoices but the field name suggests 'scheduled for payment' which usually includes held-but-cleared. Acceptable for demo; document intent.

issues: React Router v6 future-flag warnings still present (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — same as iter 1/2, non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1955 lines — past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/ subpackage (auth, vendors, workflow, sap, categories, compliance, po_grn, invoices) before iter 6.

_3way_match dynamically grows `total` by branch, so confidence percentages aren't comparable across invoices with/without PO (a no-PO invoice maxes out at score=1/total=2 = 50% before flags push it to blocked anyway). Acceptable since verdict is gated by has_block, but the displayed % can mislead users.

Invoice seed inserts the match_result inline at line 1829 then sets status from it — fine; but the seed passes a *synthetic* invoice dict to _3way_match (only vendor_id/subtotal/invoice_date/lines), so the qty-mismatch branch can't see invoice line qty deviations. That's why agent-context note says seeds won't auto_approve.
POIn.lines is List[POLineIn] (typed) but GRNIn.lines is List[dict] (untyped) — inconsistency; should be List[GRNLineIn].
/api/invoices/run-bot reruns ALL held/pending and stores match_run_at but doesn't return a list of changed invoice_ids — caller has to refetch.

rca of the issue: OCR 500 RCA: In /app/backend/server.py:1935, the OCR endpoint constructs ImageContent(image_url=body.image_url). The installed emergentintegrations.llm.chat.ImageContent class only accepts image_base64 (verified: `inspect.signature(ImageContent.__init__) == (self, image_base64: str)`). This raises TypeError before reaching the try/except wrapped around chat.send_message, so FastAPI converts it to a generic 500. Reproduction: POST /api/invoices/ocr-extract {image_url:'https://picsum.photos/300/400'} as admin → returns 500. Mitigation (2 lines): import httpx + base64; fetch the URL, base64-encode and pass image_base64=encoded. Also extend the try/except to cover ImageContent(...) construction so any future SDK change still surfaces as 502.
